title: Olivér Nagy
text:
I am an economist turned quantitative developer. My experience spans from monetary policy analysis, through policy evaluation and forecasting, to curve-fitting engine development. Nowadays, I mainly write code in Python and C++, but I professionally worked with R, SQL, MATLAB and Stata as well.
I work at the intersection of quantitative finance, econometrics, and scientific computing. My current research focuses on volatility modelling, asset pricing, and financial-market responses to events. More broadly, I am interested in solving modelling problems with computational methods.
